rejected: cannot serve 200K context on 12GB. Its VRAM cost per context token is ~57 KB (measured 32K->64K = 1.80 GiB) vs llama.cpp q8 KV ~12.7 KB, so 200K needs ~11.5 GB for context alone; at 236K the engine reports 0 MiB free and refuses. Speed where it does run (32768 ctx): 49.8 t/s vs llama.cpp 58.5 at the same ctx (-15%), prefill 657 vs 823. Also: its setup mis-sizes --expert-vram (assumes 3 GB of weights+context, real ~7 GB).

correction: the eval rows recorded for this model before 2026-10-20T02:00Z are invalid. The gate ran ./golem eval through WSL (for python3), environment variables do not cross that boundary, so GOLEM_MODEL_ALIAS was dropped and the harness evaluated MODEL_ALIAS from .env - the Ornith-35B - while the row was written under the 0.5B name. Their 35B rates give them away: needle_prefill 867-883 t/s and depth_decode 43-49 t/s, where the 0.5B measures 18346 and 266.6. Nothing was adopted from them.
